name: Honjou Manami
source:
An ordinary schoolgirl who just transferred to a local school.

Since she has only recently moved and doesn’t know much about her surroundings, she learns various things from [url=https://vndb.org/c84534]Manami[/url].
She has a rather unassertive personality and tries not to stand out in class.

In truth, she is a lesbian and feels drawn to her classmate Manami, but lacking the courage to confess, she interacts with her only as a normal friend.
